correctness.rationale: For full-column-rank \(A\), \(B=A^{\mathsf T}A\) is positive definite and the LM step gives exactly \(x_{k+1}=\lambda_k(B+\lambda_k I)^{-1}x_k\). Affine exactness makes predicted and current-residual actual reductions coincide, while the nonmonotone window can only increase the numerator, proving \(\widehat r_k\ge1\) and the exact quartering of \(\mu_k\). The damping bound follows from \(\sup_{t\ge1}t^{1/t}=e^{1/e}\). The zero quadratic ratio follows from an explicit \(C\|x_k\|^{2+1/\ln(k+e)}\) bound plus the resulting double-exponential lower growth of \(-\ln\|x_k\|\). A standalone verifier replays representative multi-mode and log-domain calculations.

value.rationale: The result identifies a structurally natural exact-model class on which the source's nonmonotone globalization becomes completely inactive, gives a closed damping-control law and an explicit global contraction, and shows that the slowly vanishing exponent excess produces a zero quadratic constant even though the paper's general theorem only reports quadratic convergence in the smooth full-rank case. This is a useful calibration result for interpreting the new parameter rule, not a cosmetic reparameterization or a table recomputation.
